summary: Cheshire County, NH lookout placed in service 1930 (1939 newspaper suggests later); unused after 2005 and removed by the state in June 2020; one footing remains.

facts.design: 53-foot steel tower with standard NH wooden cab (register); 80-foot tower (2016 newspaper quoted by Forest Lookouts)
facts.status_note: A state contractor removed the tower in early June 2020; only one tower footing remains at the site, per the 2020 NH chapter report.

staffing.status: Visit reports disagree: 2017 says staffed sometimes by the state of New Hampshire; 2012 says not staffed

visit.trail_note: Hike guide describes an unmarked trailhead and a walk with no views at the top; the 2017 register visit report said the trail is easy to follow but the trailhead could use better marking. The tower is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and hike guide give 1930 as the start of service. A May 1939 newspaper item describes buying land and erecting a tower at once. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

Register says the tower was a 53-foot steel tower; a 2016 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts says 80 feet. The brief record's 24.4 m (80 ft) follows the newspaper. Height is left out of facts pending editor review.
2012 visit report says not staffed; 2017 visit report says staffed sometimes by the state. Story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Built date conflict: 1930 (register and hike guide) versus a May 1939 newspaper item about buying land and erecting a tower at once; the 1939 item may concern a replacement or a new site, which no source confirms. Height conflict: 53 ft (register) versus 80 ft (2016 newspaper); the brief's 24.4 m matches the newspaper, so it is not proposed as an error. Brief event 2002 registration and 2020 removal are confirmed. The 2020 report is by the FFLA New Hampshire chapter and names a state contractor; the brief's 'removed' date is 'early June 2020'. Pack Monadnock's NHLR entry says it replaces the Hyland Hill fire tower 'which is still maintained' (search snippet, not read; not used). No photos added: none with a stated license in the pages read.
